economy.summary: His official Pennsylvania House biography lists increasing good-paying jobs with fair wages among his priorities.
economy.short: Lists increasing good-paying jobs with fair wages as a priority.

education.summary: His official Pennsylvania House biography lists properly funding public schools in the district and across Pennsylvania among his priorities.
education.short: Lists properly funding public schools as a priority.

abortion.summary: His official Pennsylvania House biography lists protecting reproductive freedom among his priorities.
abortion.short: Lists protecting reproductive freedom as a priority.

guns.summary: His official Pennsylvania House biography lists keeping Northeast Philadelphia safe and the justice system fair among his priorities; this is a general public-safety statement rather than a position specific to firearms.
guns.short: Lists keeping Northeast Philadelphia safe, justice system fair, as priority.
